# Authentication

* API Key (hmac)
    - Parameter Name: **Authorization**, in: header. Amazon Signature authorization v4

<h1 id="amazon-pinpoint-default">Default</h1>

## GetApps

<a id="opIdGetApps"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://pinpoint.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v1/apps \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/apps`

Retrieves information about all the applications that are associated with your Amazon Pinpoint account.

<h3 id="getapps-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page-size|query|string|false|The maximum number of items to include in each page of a paginated response. This parameter is not supported for application, campaign, and journey metrics.|
|token|query|string|false|The NextToken string that specifies which page of results to return in a paginated response.|
|X-Amz-Content-Sha256|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Date|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Algorithm|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Credential|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Security-Token|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Signature|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-SignedHeaders|header|string|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "ApplicationsResponse": {
    "Item": {},
    "NextToken": {}
  }
}
```

```json
null
```

## CreateApp

<a id="opIdCreateApp"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://pinpoint.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v1/apps \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "CreateApplicationRequest": {
      "Name": {},
      "tags": {
        "property1": "string",
        "property2": "string"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1/apps`

 <p>Creates an application.</p>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "CreateApplicationRequest": {
    "Name": {},
    "tags": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

|X-Amz-Security-Token|header|string|false|none|

|X-Amz-SignedHeaders|header|string|false|none|

## GetCampaigns

<a id="opIdGetCampaigns"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://pinpoint.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v1/apps/string/campaigns \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/apps/{application-id}/campaigns`

Retrieves information about the status, configuration, and other settings for all the campaigns that are associated with an application.

<h3 id="getcampaigns-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|application-id|path|string|true|The unique identifier for the application. This identifier is displayed as the <b>Project ID</b> on the Amazon Pinpoint console.|
|page-size|query|string|false|The maximum number of items to include in each page of a paginated response. This parameter is not supported for application, campaign, and journey metrics.|
|token|query|string|false|The NextToken string that specifies which page of results to return in a paginated response.|
|X-Amz-Content-Sha256|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Date|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Algorithm|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Credential|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Security-Token|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Signature|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-SignedHeaders|header|string|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "CampaignsResponse": {
    "Item": {},
    "NextToken": {}
  }
}
```

## GetEmailTemplate

<a id="opIdGetEmailTemplate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://pinpoint.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v1/templates/string/email \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/templates/{template-name}/email`

Retrieves the content and settings of a message template for messages that are sent through the email channel.

<h3 id="getemailtemplate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|template-name|path|string|true|The name of the message template. A template name must start with an alphanumeric character and can contain a maximum of 128 characters. The characters can be alphanumeric characters, underscores (_), or hyphens (-). Template names are case sensitive.|
|version|query|string|false|<p>The unique identifier for the version of the message template to update, retrieve information about, or delete. To retrieve identifiers and other information for all the versions of a template, use the <link  linkend="templates-template-name-template-type-versions">Template Versions</link> resource.</p> <p>If specified, this value must match the identifier for an existing template version. If specified for an update operation, this value must match the identifier for the latest existing version of the template. This restriction helps ensure that race conditions don't occur.</p> <p>If you don't specify a value for this parameter, Amazon Pinpoint does the following:</p> <ul><li><p>For a get operation, retrieves information about the active version of the template.</p></li> <li><p>For an update operation, saves the updates to (overwrites) the latest existing version of the template, if the create-new-version parameter isn't used or is set to false.</p></li> <li><p>For a delete operation, deletes the template, including all versions of the template.</p></li></ul>|
|X-Amz-Content-Sha256|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Date|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Algorithm|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Credential|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Security-Token|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Signature|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-SignedHeaders|header|string|false|none|

To retrieve identifiers and other information for all the versions of a template, use the <link  linkend="templates-template-name-template-type-versions">Template Versions</link> resource.</p> <p>If specified, this value must match the identifier for an existing template version. If specified for an update operation, this value must match the identifier for the latest existing version of the template. This restriction helps ensure that race conditions don't occur.</p> <p>If you don't specify a value for this parameter, Amazon Pinpoint does the following:</p> <ul><li><p>For a get operation, retrieves information about the active version of the template.</p></li> <li><p>For an update operation, saves the updates to (overwrites) the latest existing version of the template, if the create-new-version parameter isn't used or is set to false.</p></li> <li><p>For a delete operation, deletes the template, including all versions of the template.</p></li></ul>|

## GetPushTemplate

<a id="opIdGetPushTemplate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://pinpoint.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v1/templates/string/push \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/templates/{template-name}/push`

Retrieves the content and settings of a message template for messages that are sent through a push notification channel.

<h3 id="getpushtemplate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|template-name|path|string|true|The name of the message template. A template name must start with an alphanumeric character and can contain a maximum of 128 characters. The characters can be alphanumeric characters, underscores (_), or hyphens (-). Template names are case sensitive.|
|version|query|string|false|<p>The unique identifier for the version of the message template to update, retrieve information about, or delete. To retrieve identifiers and other information for all the versions of a template, use the <link  linkend="templates-template-name-template-type-versions">Template Versions</link> resource.</p> <p>If specified, this value must match the identifier for an existing template version. If specified for an update operation, this value must match the identifier for the latest existing version of the template. This restriction helps ensure that race conditions don't occur.</p> <p>If you don't specify a value for this parameter, Amazon Pinpoint does the following:</p> <ul><li><p>For a get operation, retrieves information about the active version of the template.</p></li> <li><p>For an update operation, saves the updates to (overwrites) the latest existing version of the template, if the create-new-version parameter isn't used or is set to false.</p></li> <li><p>For a delete operation, deletes the template, including all versions of the template.</p></li></ul>|
|X-Amz-Content-Sha256|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Date|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Algorithm|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Credential|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Security-Token|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Signature|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-SignedHeaders|header|string|false|none|

`DELETE /v1/templates/{template-name}/push`

Deletes a message template for messages that were sent through a push notification channel.

<h3 id="deletepushtemplate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|template-name|path|string|true|The name of the message template. A template name must start with an alphanumeric character and can contain a maximum of 128 characters. The characters can be alphanumeric characters, underscores (_), or hyphens (-). Template names are case sensitive.|
|version|query|string|false|<p>The unique identifier for the version of the message template to update, retrieve information about, or delete. To retrieve identifiers and other information for all the versions of a template, use the <link  linkend="templates-template-name-template-type-versions">Template Versions</link> resource.</p> <p>If specified, this value must match the identifier for an existing template version. If specified for an update operation, this value must match the identifier for the latest existing version of the template. This restriction helps ensure that race conditions don't occur.</p> <p>If you don't specify a value for this parameter, Amazon Pinpoint does the following:</p> <ul><li><p>For a get operation, retrieves information about the active version of the template.</p></li> <li><p>For an update operation, saves the updates to (overwrites) the latest existing version of the template, if the create-new-version parameter isn't used or is set to false.</p></li> <li><p>For a delete operation, deletes the template, including all versions of the template.</p></li></ul>|
|X-Amz-Content-Sha256|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Date|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Algorithm|header|string|false|none|

## DeleteCampaign

Retrieves all the tags (keys and values) that are associated with an application, campaign, message template, or segment.

|X-Amz-Date|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Algorithm|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Credential|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Security-Token|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Signature|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-SignedHeaders|header|string|false|none|

> Example responses

```json
    "tags": {

```

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

```

`GET /v1/templates/{template-name}/{template-type}/versions`

Retrieves information about all the versions of a specific message template.

<h3 id="listtemplateversions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next-token|query|string|false|The  string that specifies which page of results to return in a paginated response. This parameter is not supported for application, campaign, and journey metrics.|
|page-size|query|string|false|The maximum number of items to include in each page of a paginated response. This parameter is not supported for application, campaign, and journey metrics.|
|template-name|path|string|true|The name of the message template. A template name must start with an alphanumeric character and can contain a maximum of 128 characters. The characters can be alphanumeric characters, underscores (_), or hyphens (-). Template names are case sensitive.|
|template-type|path|string|true|The type of channel that the message template is designed for. Valid values are: EMAIL, PUSH, SMS, and VOICE.|
|X-Amz-Content-Sha256|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Date|header|string|false|none|

## RemoveAttributes

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://pinpoint.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/v1/apps/string/attributes/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

      "Blacklist": {}
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/apps/{application-id}/attributes/{attribute-type}`

Removes one or more attributes, of the same attribute type, from all the endpoints that are associated with an application.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "UpdateAttributesRequest": {
    "Blacklist": {}
  }
}
```

<h3 id="removeattributes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|application-id|path|string|true|The unique identifier for the application. This identifier is displayed as the <b>Project ID</b> on the Amazon Pinpoint console.|
|attribute-type|path|string|true| <p>The type of attribute or attributes to remove. Valid values are:</p> <ul><li><p>endpoint-custom-attributes - Custom attributes that describe endpoints, such as the date when an associated user opted in or out of receiving communications from you through a specific type of channel.</p></li> <li><p>endpoint-metric-attributes - Custom metrics that your app reports to Amazon Pinpoint for endpoints, such as the number of app sessions or the number of items left in a cart.</p></li> <li><p>endpoint-user-attributes - Custom attributes that describe users, such as first name, last name, and age.</p></li></ul>|
|X-Amz-Content-Sha256|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Date|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Algorithm|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Credential|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Security-Token|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-Signature|header|string|false|none|
|X-Amz-SignedHeaders|header|string|false|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» UpdateAttributesRequest|body|object|true|Specifies one or more attributes to remove from all the endpoints that are associated with an application.|
|» » Blacklist|body|object|false|none|
